text: Orders are shipped within 2 working days after payment. Tracking number is shown in the order page once shipped.
West Malaysia delivery usually takes 2-5 working days after shipping; East Malaysia 5-10 working days. Delivery times are estimates set by the courier.
Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery for unworn items with tags. The buyer starts the return in the platform app.
Refunds are decided by the shop owner after the returned item is received and checked, and are paid through the platform.
Size exchange is possible within 7 days of delivery if stock is available. The buyer pays the return postage unless the shop sent the wrong item.
For damaged, wrong or missing items, ask the buyer for photos of the item and the parcel label and the order number. The owner decides the solution.
Orders can be cancelled in the platform app before they are shipped. After shipping, the buyer must request a return instead.
If payment was deducted but no order appears, ask the buyer for a screenshot of the payment and the time of payment; the owner checks with the platform.
Size charts are in the product photos. Sizes run small; suggest one size up if between sizes.
TikTok Shop orders: returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery for unworn items with tags. The buyer starts the return in the TikTok Shop app.
